_comment: Reviewed evaluation dataset for the You.com discovery layer. approved_hosts for pipedrive, twenty, hubspot and attio are copied verbatim from the already-reviewed ops/browser_host_policy.py registry (do not diverge from that file without re-reviewing both). twilio, slack and zoho were verified via direct source lookup during this integration (see docs/YOU_COM_INTEGRATION.md); they are NOT yet cross-reviewed against ops/browser_host_policy.py because none of the three has an entry there. expected_categories is intentionally the categories a REAL verified URL for that app actually produces from ops.you_research.classify_category, not an aspirational list: the classifier is keyword-based, so a bare root URL with no path keywords (e.g. a plain login SPA at https://app.twenty.com/) classifies as 'unknown' even though a human would recognize it as a login page. That is a documented, honest limitation (see docs/YOU_COM_INTEGRATION.md) rather than something this dataset papers over. The 'unknown-nonexistent-vendor' entry is a deliberately nonexistent vendor used to verify the pipeline degrades to a truthful empty result rather than fabricating hosts or categories.
